title: Sewing Kit 104 Pieces – Everything in One Case
descriptionHtml:
The button comes off and the whole home lacks a needle

The hem that came undone, the button in your hand five minutes before leaving – and the nearest needle and thread are in another home.

The whole sewing box in one case with a zipper

104 pieces in one case: 24 thread colors, needles, scissors, measuring tape, snap fasteners and needle threaders – sorted into their own holders so it looks the same after the fifth use. In the dresser drawer at home or in the suitcase.

Features

  • The button is sewn on in five minutes – thread, needle and scissors in the same place
  • 104 pieces with their own places – the kit looks the same after every use
  • 24 thread colors – the right color for the garment instead of the closest one
  • Fits in the suitcase – flat case with a zipper

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
